summary: Read and write person availability and report device presence through client-v0

replay.detail: The routes write the existing availability claim kinds; replay is unchanged.

schema.detail: No claim kind or projection changes. The client-v0 contract adds PersonAvailability, PersonAvailabilities, AvailabilitySet with its per-axis changes, and PresenceReport.

rules.detail: GET /v1/client/availability (read.projections) shows raw presence only to the person; other readers get the effective status, interruptions and deadline clock. PUT /v1/client/availability (write.availability) and POST /v1/client/presence (write.presence) act as the session's own person and refuse agent sessions. The daemon assigns each presence source: the pairing grant, or host/<member> for local callers.

compatibility.detail: Public client contract addition: availability.list, availability.set and presence.report with generated Rust, Swift and TypeScript methods. New scopes write.availability and write.presence join the default limited pairing grant; existing paired devices keep their sealed scopes and must be re-paired to acquire them.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or service interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action. Re-pair a device that should report presence or set availability.

recovery.detail: A person corrects availability by writing a newer value; presence reports age out after 15 minutes.
